frameworks.name: Spring Boot
frameworks.note: Newest patch per line: mvn dependency:list of the web, validation, actuator and test starters; g9WithOverrides sets pom properties.

hints.text: Start on Boot 4.1.1 or 4.0.8: 0 failing advisories with the Tomcat and Jackson notes' pom properties. No 3.x line resolves clean: Boot 3.5.16 manages spring-webmvc 6.2.19, and GHSA-j9f9-w8pj-32f8, GHSA-pc63-qcmh-9cmg have no 6.2.x fix; Boot 4 manages 7.0.9.
The released BOM ships a Tomcat with failing advisories. Pom property tomcat.version=11.0.25 on Boot 4.1.1 and 4.0.8 (Tomcat 11). No Tomcat override makes a 3.x line clean (see the Spring note).
Pom properties. Boot 4.1.1 (Jackson 3): jackson-bom.version=3.1.7. Boot 4.0.8: jackson-bom.version=3.1.7; a Boot 4 tree that also holds Jackson 2 needs jackson-2-bom.version=2.21.7.
WebFlux brings Netty. Boot 4.1.1: no override needed. Boot 4.0.8: no override needed.
Boot 4.1.1: no override needed. Boot 4.0.8: no override needed.

promptGuidance.text: Spring Boot: start on 4.1.1 or 4.0.8 (Spring Framework 7.0.9). Boot 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5 fail G9 even with pom overrides: Boot 3.5.16 manages Spring Framework 6.2.19, and GHSA-j9f9-w8pj-32f8, GHSA-pc63-qcmh-9cmg (spring-webmvc) have no 6.2.x fix.

Boot 4.1.1 starters: spring-boot-starter-webmvc (spring-boot-starter-web is deprecated); spring-boot-starter-flyway (FlywayAutoConfiguration is in spring-boot-flyway, not flyway-core) and org.flywaydb:flyway-database-postgresql for PostgreSQL.

Boot 4.1.1 JPA test slice (spring-boot-starter-data-jpa-test): org.springframework.boot.data.jpa.test.autoconfigure.DataJpaTest and org.springframework.boot.jdbc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureTestDatabase; Boot 3 had both in spring-boot-test-autoconfigure.

Boot 4.1.1 web test slice (spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test): org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.WebMvcTest and org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc. No MockBean: use org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean.

Boot 4: org.springframework.boot.resttestclient.TestRestTemplate with org.springframework.boot.resttestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureTestRestTemplate needs spring-boot-resttestclient plus org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-restclient (no version; test scope unless main code already has it).
Without spring-boot-restclient the context fails with NoClassDefFoundError RestTemplateBuilder: spring-boot-resttestclient 4.1.1 and 4.0.8 do not depend on it.

Testcontainers 2.0.5 (Boot 4.1.1 and 4.0.8 manage it): org.testcontainers:testcontainers-postgresql and org.testcontainers:testcontainers-junit-jupiter. Boot 4 gives the 1.x names postgresql and junit-jupiter (last 1.21.4) no version.

unverified: Whether Boot 3.3 and 3.4 are still maintained (no support-policy page was fetched).
Gradle: the trees were resolved with Maven; Gradle's resolver was not run.
